Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its "Updated Understanding" section. After the WebSurfer correctly identified the birthplace as "Naha, Okinawa, Japan," the Planner incorrectly equated "Naha" with "Okinawa City." Naha is a city (the capital of Okinawa Prefecture), but it is not named "Okinawa City"; the city is simply Naha. By changing the specific city name "Naha" to the non-existent "Okinawa City," the Planner introduced a factual inaccuracy that led to the wrong final answer ("Okinawa City" instead of "Naha").
